$1.65 EPS Expected for NetEase, Inc. (NTES) Posted by Hazel Jackson 14 pm
Analysts expect NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) to report $1.65 EPS on February, 6.They anticipate $0.16 EPS change or 10.74 % from last quarter’s $1.49 EPS. NTES’s profit would be $216.69M giving it 39.16 P/E if the $1.65 EPS is correct. After having $1.80 EPS previously, NetEase, Inc.’s analysts see -8.33 % EPS growth. The stock increased 6.61% or $16.03 during the last trading session, reaching $258.44. About 1.23 million shares traded or 40.45% up from the average. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has declined 26.07% since January 10, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.07% the S&P500. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) Ratings Coverage
Among 6 analysts covering NetEase ( NASDAQ:NTES ), 5 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 83% are positive. NetEase had 9 analyst reports since July 30, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Barclays Capital maintained NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) rating on Monday, July 30. Barclays Capital has “Equal-Weight” rating and $275 target. The company was upgraded on Thursday, December 6 by Morgan Stanley. The stock of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, December 19 by UBS. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, November 16 by Nomura. The stock has “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Friday, September 21. The stock of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Barclays Capital on Thursday, August 30. Barclays Capital maintained the shares of NTES in report on Friday, November 16 with “Equal-Weight” rating. The stock of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has “Overweight” rating given on Friday, August 10 by JP Morgan. As per Friday, August 10, the company rating was maintained by Nomura.
NetEase, Inc. operates an interactive online community in the People's Republic of China. The company has market cap of $33.94 billion. The firm operates through Online Game Services; Advertising Services; and E-mail, E-commerce and Others divisions. It has a 38.75 P/E ratio. It offers PC-client massively multi-player online role-playing games and mobile games; and distributes its point cards to gamers.
